versions.changelog:
streme-launcher 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launch tokens on Streme (streme.fun) using V2 contracts on Base.
- Supports deploying SuperTokens with built-in Uniswap V3 liquidity, Superfluid staking rewards, and optional vesting vaults.
- Provides allocation helpers for staking and vesting configurations.
- Includes deployment guides, contract addresses, image hosting instructions, and API endpoints.
- Example scripts and patterns for standard, team-vested, and LP-max launch scenarios.
